report:
Thyroid, total thyroidectomy

Received in formalin is a total thyroidectomy specimen weighing 28 g and measuring right lobe 5 x 3 x 2 cm, left lobe 4.5 x 2.5 x 2 cm, isthmus 2 x 1.5 x 0.8 cm. The thyroid capsule is intact. Sectioning shows a firm, pale white infiltrative mass in the right lobe measuring 18 x 15 x 12 mm. The background parenchyma is unremarkable. Representative sections are taken in 10 blocks.

(1-5) Right lobe tumour with capsule and posterior margin.
(6) Isthmus.
(7-8) Left lobe.
(9-10) Central compartment lymph nodes.

Specimen and tumour
- Procedure: Total thyroidectomy
- Tumour site: Right lobe
- Tumour focality: Unifocal
- Tumour size: 18 mm (greatest dimension)
  - All dimensions: 18 x 15 x 12 mm

Microscopic findings
- Histologic type: Papillary carcinoma, classic subtype
- Mitotic count (per 2 mm2): Less than 3 mitoses per 2 mm2 (1 per 2 mm2)
- Tumour necrosis: Not identified
- Angioinvasion: Not identified
- Lymphatic invasion: Not identified
- Perineural invasion: Not identified
- Extrathyroidal extension: Not identified
- Tumour histology:
  Sections of the thyroid show papillary carcinoma, classic subtype in the right lobe. Complex branching papillae with fibrovascular cores are lined by follicular cells with enlarged, elongated, overlapping optically clear nuclei, nuclear grooves and intranuclear pseudoinclusions.

Margins
- Surgical margins: Uninvolved by carcinoma (posterior inked surface, 1.5 mm)

Lymph nodes
- Central compartment (level VI / VII): 0 of 6 involved (level VI)

Pathological stage (AJCC 8th edition)
- pTNM: pT1b pN0a

Additional findings
- Additional pathologic findings: Thyroiditis (chronic lymphocytic thyroiditis)

THYROID, total thyroidectomy:
- PAPILLARY CARCINOMA, classic subtype, 18 mm
- Margins clear
- 0 of 6 central compartment lymph nodes involved
- pT1b pN0a (AJCC 8th edition).
